resources.string: Shows a small gesture handle over other apps. It receives app-window change events only and does not read screen contents or send data. Tap or swipe up briefly on the handle to request Home, or swipe up and hold to request Recents.
Gesture fallback handle. Tap or swipe up for Home, or swipe up and hold for Recents.
